local: O arise all you sons of this land,
Let us sing of our joy to be free,
Praising God and rejoicing to be
english: O arise all you sons of this land,
Let us sing of our joy to be free,
Praising God and rejoicing to be

local: Shout our name from the mountains to seas
Let us raise our voices and proclaim
english: Shout our name from the mountains to seas
Let us raise our voices and proclaim

local: Now give thanks to the good Lord above
For His kindness, His wisdom and love
For this land of our fathers so free,
english: Now give thanks to the good Lord above
For His kindness, His wisdom and love
For this land of our fathers so free,

local: Shout again for the whole world to hear
english: Shout again for the whole world to hear
